Put an image of your GAMETITLE CD (.iso or .bin) next to mygame.exe
(Linux: mygame), or put your copy of the game (PC version) into this folder:
the contents of the CD, an image of the CD (.iso or .bin), or your
installed game folder.

At its next start mygame finds the game, checks that it is a version
this port knows, and sets it up here:

  GAMEFOLDER\   the game's EXE and data (and your settings and saved games)
  Video\        the videos, if the game has any on its CD

From a CD image these are taken out; the image stays where it is.
Nothing in this folder is ever deleted: remove the image or other
copies yourself once the game runs.
